provenance.note: Carbines in handgun calibers from .35, metres or yards by announcement (D.36.7). Six sighters at 50 m (D.36.12). Sports Carbine PP2 Rifle .223 (D.36.19, Teil D, PDF p. 284) is scored separately. The course runs at 10, 50 and 25 m, the record holds the longest distance. The trigger minimum is 1135 g for revolver carbines in single action and 1360 g otherwise, so no single value is set. A maximum muzzle energy of 600 J applies.
